lines.text: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus calls out that whoever believes in Him will have streams of living water.
John explains that Jesus was speaking about the Spirit, whom believers were later to receive.
Some in the crowd call Jesus the Prophet, while others object that the Christ cannot come from Samaria.
Some want to seize Jesus, but the officers return without Him and say never has anyone spoken like this man.
Nicodemus asks whether their law allows arresting a man at a feast, and they tell him to look into it.

wrong_details.wrong: allows arresting a man at a feast
wrong_details.true: convict a man without first hearing from him
